_provenance.model: Calibrated to the GRACEnet measurements on this field (scripts/calibrate/optimize.py, 15,616 evals). Objective is per-year yield error over all seven rotation years plus the newly-extracted seven-year April soil-nitrate trajectory, with PET held as a bound against measured AgriMet ETos. Yield RMS per-year 25.5% -> 13.6%, PBIAS -9.8% -> -3.0% (corn -7.0, alfa +2.2, barl -4.9), PET unchanged at +0.0%. n_perc and fr_hum_act are held at their sourced values: the fit moved both but doing so made yield worse. Also repoints the harvest index at harv.ops, where the engine actually reads it - plants.plt:harv_idx is inert for this rotation (PROVENANCE 5i, 5j).
_provenance.note: Regression gate. A different SWAT+ build (e.g. a Linux/WSL ELF engine) must reproduce these numbers; a deviation is build disagreement, not a code bug. Regenerate with scripts/rebaseline.py.
